model.name: R19.41: Server has a configurable log level that gates logging detail at runtime.
model.description: The server MUST have a configurable LOG LEVEL with standard verbosity tiers (error < warn < info < debug < trace). All server logging (including the file-upload/createFileUnit diligent logging from R19.36) respects the active level — messages below the threshold are suppressed. The level MUST be settable at runtime without server restart (e.g. via admin API endpoint or WS command) AND have a persisted default (env var or config file read at startup). This enables increasing detail for debugging and decreasing for production noise.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "introduce serverside log level to increase and decrease server log details."
